title: Foreign Asset Disclosure: Rectifying Missed ITR Filings
description: The Annual Information Statement (AIS) on the Income Tax e-filing portal now displays foreign asset and income details for 2022-24. This new data availability.

faq.a: The Annual Information Statement (AIS) is a comprehensive statement containing details of financial transactions undertaken by a taxpayer during a financial year, available on the Income Tax e-filing portal.

faq.q: Do NRIs need to disclose foreign assets?
faq.a: Generally, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) are not required to disclose foreign assets in their Indian Income Tax Returns, as their global income and assets are not taxable in India. However, if they become a Resident, the disclosure requirements apply.

faq.q: What if I had a foreign bank account but closed it?
faq.a: If you held a foreign bank account at any time during the financial year for which you are filing the ITR, it needs to be disclosed in Schedule FA, even if it was subsequently closed.

faq.q: Is a gift from abroad considered a foreign asset?
faq.a: A gift received from abroad itself is not a foreign asset for disclosure in Schedule FA. However, if that gift is in the form of a foreign bank account balance or foreign shares, then the underlying asset needs to be disclosed.

faq.q: What is the Black Money Act?
faq.a: The Black Money (Undisclosed Foreign Income and Assets) Imposition of Tax Act, 2015, is a specific law enacted in India to deal with the problem of undisclosed foreign income and assets.

faq.q: Can ITR-U be filed for any reason?
faq.a: No, ITR-U cannot be filed if it results in a refund, decreases the tax liability, or if certain proceedings like search or survey have been initiated against the taxpayer.

faq.q: Is there a minimum value for foreign assets to be disclosed?
faq.a: No, there is no minimum threshold value for disclosing foreign assets. All foreign assets held by a resident Indian at any time during the financial year must be disclosed in Schedule FA, irrespective of their value.

based_on.title: Foreign asset details for 2022-24 now available under AIS: What to do if you missed disclosing them in previous ITRs?
